title: Book 3 — Thalia, Chapter 93
paragraphs: From Pactyïke, the Armenians, and the peoples bordering on them as far as the Euxine, four hundred talents: this is the thirteenth division. From the Sagartians, Sarangians, Thamanaians, Utians, Mycans, and those dwelling in the islands of the Erythraian Sea—where the king settles those called the “Removed”—from all these together a tribute of six hundred talents was produced: this is the fourteenth division. The Sacans and Caspians brought in two hundred and fifty talents: this is the fifteenth division. The Parthians, Chorasmians, Sogdians, and Areians: three hundred talents: this is the sixteenth division.
